verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Bitwarden generates TOTP codes, both in the vault and in the separate Authenticator app, and that it can sync and import codes. No evidence item documents searching codes, putting them in folders or groups, or showing service icons. The Public API's "collections, groups" refers to managing organization members, which is an adjacent feature and does not organize tokens.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away
